violations.title: FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY missing
violations.message: Table public.journal_entries has RLS enabled but not FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. The table owner role still bypasses RLS, which often masks broken policies in development and CI. Run `ALTER TABLE public.journal_entries FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;`.

violations.title: All policies on table are permissive
violations.message: Every policy on public.journal_entries is permissive. Permissive policies combine with OR — adding one RESTRICTIVE policy gives a floor (e.g. tenant scoping) that no OR branch can bypass, for the roles in its own TO list. Use TO PUBLIC to bind every role: measured, a restrictive TO authenticated left authenticated at 1 row and another role at 3.
